action_items: Confirm whether Annular_Frac was supposed to gain density_hi/rate_hi/rop_hi thresholds too — the review request lists them as part of the 'expanded threshold set' but only surfp_hi exists in server.py.

Optional polish: the Rig Selector strip on the workbook layout uses 'All data filtered by rig' text at #666 on #1E1E1E background — passes AA barely but very faint. Consider #9CA3AF for consistency with the ACTIVE RIG label.
critical_code_review_comments: RigChecklists summary useMemo reads localStorage directly and depends on [rigId, openTier] — it will NOT update when a checkbox is toggled inside the currently-open tier because tier-internal state (items) lives in ChecklistTier and doesn't bubble up. In practice the summary badge does not increment live when you tick an item; it only recomputes on rig-switch, tab-switch, or open/close. Observed in the test: after clicking flha_am and rechecking the summary text on the same tab, tests read via the tier badge (which does update correctly) — but the top-line 'RIG 1 CHECKLISTS · Safety 0/6' summary can drift out of sync with tier badges until a re-open. Consider lifting items state into RigChecklists or using a small pub/sub / storage event to force recompute.
RigChecklists.jsx line 12: object literal uses inconsistent key-quoting ({ id: 'h2s_check', 'label': ... }). Works but stylistically flags most linters.

TeamItemsList always passes rig_id on POST — a user viewing legacy (untagged) items and creating a new one will silently tag it to their current active rig. That's per-spec but worth noting for legacy migration.

loadState() seeds default library on first read for a rig. If DEFAULT_LIB is ever updated (new items added later), existing rigs will NEVER see the new defaults because their localStorage snapshot is already populated. Consider merging by id (union of stored + defaults) on load.
